reviews.title: Already Paying for Premium,Yet Basic Reactions Arent Included & Stickers Cost Extra For Each Person?
reviews.text:
I genuinely love the concept of FamilyAlbum and being able to share precious memories of my children with family members. However, I’m extremely disappointed that even basic reactions, such as a heart or smiley face, require an additional paid subscription.

What makes this especially frustrating is that I’m already paying for Premium. As a paying customer, I would expect something as simple as allowing family members to react to photos and videos to be included, especially when the whole purpose of the app is to bring families closer together.

Almost every messaging and photo-sharing app offers a simple, one-tap like or heart reaction. It’s something people are accustomed to, so not having it feels strangely outdated and inconvenient. If grandparents or other relatives want to quickly show their appreciation for a photo or video, they should be able to tap a heart and move on.

Instead, they have to click the comment section, type an emoji or message, and submit it (That is a total of 3 actions which is a waste of time and this is not user friendly in todays social media). Something that should take one tap now requires multiple steps. It may seem like a minor inconvenience, but when family members are scrolling through dozen or more of photos and videos, it becomes tedious.

Didn’t mind the small ads at the top but now this ruins the entire experience. Before the full screen ads I was recommending it to all my friends with children now those recommendations have ceased

reviews.title: Removed the ability to select different albums
reviews.text: Love this app, used it for 11 months with my baby, but I always heart my favourite photos and post them in bulk every now and then using the ‘favourites’ album on iPhone album. You can no longer do this and now I have to scroll through thousands of photos to find the photo/s I want to upload. This has made the app physically unusable for me, as I use my phone for work photos which could be hundreds a week, plus I take 20-50 anytime I photograph my son, and heart the best ones so I’d be scrolling for a month before I retrieved all the photos I wanted to upload. Really hope you bring this feature back.

reviews.title: Useless if more than one album within family
reviews.text: It’s  okay if you only have one album but when you start having multiple family members with multiple albums, the app doesn’t always register when you’re invited to another album and will just glitch out. Until this gets fixed, we will no longer be using this app.

reviews.title: 6 YEAR PAYING MEMBER
reviews.text: Every single time I open the app I’m met with inner promotions from books to mugs to stickers I truly believe if I’m paying 110$ a year for premium to avoid ad content it should also be from the app itself and stop pushing and suggesting at every turn I open the app. I know where the shop it I know the store has stuff and I know they have stickers as well the excessive push for it in honesty deters me I’ve ordered books through family album before when there wasn’t such a push for inner promotions but since it and the excessive amount for pop up content and every single time I open this app makes me no longer buy it and is making me question if their is a better app out there or perhaps cold hard copies of photos. If I’m being met with so much promotion and so is any family member that just wants to simply catch up memories and photos instead gets promotions pushed on us at every turn despite paying a premium then perhaps looking for something else is better after being a longtime member of 6years I think inner promotions are destroying the whole premise of premium features and “ ad free content “ we all know is inner promotion is just another way of disguising it as what it truly is. Before all this push this app was perfect now it’s being dwindling down to a mediocre app family’s want to see their relatives adventures and catch up not a ad or promotion first. I advice you look over this with taking it off for premium subscribers.

reviews.title: No way to export your own photos in bulk
reviews.text:
I really like a lot about this app, but this is a major dealbreaker: there is no way to mass download/export the photos and videos you’ve uploaded (even with the most expensive paid subscription which advertises a “bulk download” feature). If you ever want to move to another service or simply make a backup of your own memories, you apparently have to save everything individually.

I contacted customer support hoping they could provide a bulk export or another solution, but they couldn’t help with that either. For an app specifically designed to store and share important family photos and videos, users should absolutely have a reasonable way to retrieve their own content in bulk.

I’d happily update my review if a true bulk export/data download feature is added.

reviews.text: I ordered prints 2 times and never got my them. there’s no way to track through the app so now I’m nervous some creep has my child’s pictures

reviews.title: Slowly being priced out
reviews.text:
This app started really well, and we used it all the time when our daughter was born
It’s a great way to save your photos of your child in a way that all your family can see. We live far away from most of our family, so this is a great way to keep in touch 
Unfortunately every update brings further price walls in, and I worry it will be unusable soon. I understand the need to make money, but constantly locking more and more features away behind subscriptions, features we previously had access to, whilst simultaneously adding more and more adds and plugs to your shops and partners is turning us away from the app
I hope they keep the app simple and move away from the subscription model. Nothing they offer is worth the price per month subscription, and they are removing the core engagement to stay with the app

reviews.title: Hmmm
reviews.text:
FamilyAlbum is a great functional tool for sharing with relatives without cluttering Google Photos or iCloud. However, the cost for 'Premium' to get high-quality video and computer uploads is far too expensive.
It feels like a 'double-dip' business model: the high subscription fees likely subsidize free users, yet I suspect both groups are still being targeted via trackers. While the app claims to be 'ad-free,' their App Store privacy labels show they still collect identifiers and usage data.
I’m not convinced our shared photos and metadata are completely private or that information isn't being harvested for analytics. I’d like to see a more transparent cost structure—perhaps a small, universal fee for everyone—and a firm, clear guarantee that no metadata is being harvested or sold. Until then, the high price tag feels unjustified. Until the aforementioned is ever addressed I’ll avoid this app.

What is worse, I can't upload  Photos from my iPad because the upload menu goes off the screen when it shifts.
2). The designers of the website are much more interested in selling products than making it easy to use the basic functionality of the site to upload pictures.   
3).  To use FamilyAlbum as a web based app from my windows PC I must get special permission from the App administrator, my daughter..    you have to buy premium in order to be allowed to upload photos from your computer.
